items.title: Ex-UMMC Radiographer Plans To Sue, Seeks Other Staff With Cancer, Thyroid Problems
items.summary: Former UMMC radiographer Fauzia plans to sue the hospital over alleged radiation safety breaches after failed engagement efforts. Her lawyers are seeking other workers with similar cancer problems and want UMMC to disclose radiation equipment procurement. items.title: When Will We Start Taking Mental Health Seriously? — Sitra Panirsheeluam
items.summary: When a psychiatrist concludes that an individual has a serious mental disorder, that conclusion is not made simply to protect the individual from legal consequences. It is a clinical opinion based on the person’s condition. The post When Will We Start Taking Mental Health Seriously? — Sitra Panirsheeluam appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Are We Still Practising Family Medicine? — Concerned Specialist
items.summary: The issue isn't whether FMS should be clinically strong. We absolutely should. The concern is whether “strengthening the clinical role” eventually becomes “clinical work is the main role”, as other core functions of Family Medicine are slowly pushed aside. items.title: Tribunal Orders Ex-Hospital Director To Pay RM10,000 For Sexual Harassment
items.summary: The Anti-Sexual Harassment Tribunal (TAGS) has ordered a former Sabah hospital director to pay a doctor RM10,000 compensation for sexual harassment. A doctors' group says the accused perpetrator plans to file a High Court challenge against TAGS' decision. The post Tribunal Orders Ex-Hospital Director To Pay RM10,000 For Sexual Harassment appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: MSO and MMA demand clear boundaries between optometric screening and medical diagnosis, saying optometrists aren't trained in clinical practice. items.title: Philip Morris Visits Perlis Mufti, Touts ‘Safer’ Cigarettes
items.summary: Philip Morris Malaysia and economist Muhammed Abdul Khalid met with Perlis Mufti Dr Maza yesterday. The tobacco giant touted "safer" alternatives to conventional cigarettes.
